name: meeple-economy-v1
description: ⭐ THE MEEPLE ECONOMY OF 05/09/2026, WHICH IS THE GAME reference-v14 WAS CUT AGAINST, AND THE ONLY OVERLAY THAT REPRODUCES IT. Written 09/09/2026, when Dean ruled the commons in as the engine default and the meeple economy stopped being the shipped game. Every number in reports/watchlist-2026-09-05T15-25-25-reference-v14.txt was measured on these rules, so without this file the last set of numbers this project quotes would have become unreproducible on the day the default moved. THE STANDING RULE IT SERVES: a branch whose only producer is a knob at its shipped value is not deleted. WHAT IT PINS AND WHY EACH ONE. rules.turn.visitCurrency 'meeple' - a visit costs a MEEPLE placed in the colour slot of a NEIGHBOUR's Notice Board, never your own, and the board is not a building. rules.turn.meepleAsCard true - R15: a meeple of a colour pays wherever a card of that colour would, at a build cost including the n-of-suit and 'any' slots, at a Grow's activation, at a delivery crate; never at a Sow, never at a balloon's move cost. rules.turn.meepleAsCardGoesTo 'board' - R17, and the change that made the second use affordable: the meeple is PLACED on another player's board rather than boxed, and the host collects it. rules.turn.paymentHostChoice 'perPayment' - the whole payment lands on ONE chosen host (Dean ruled per meeple and ruled it back the same day on the branching factor: 25,827 ways to buy one building at four seats against 4,063). rules.turn.paymentSlotToll 1 - the FLAT toll for landing a paid meeple on an occupied slot, however deep. rules.turn.slotToll 1 - the amended R6, and it is PER OCCUPANT rather than flat: visiting a slot holding k meeples costs k extra, all boxed. rules.turn.meepleCapPerColour null - no cap at all, Dean's ruling of 05/09/2026 and the last change the meeple game took. rules.turn.bonusTiming 'end' and rules.turn.startingMeeplesPerColour 1 - PASSENGERS OF THE COMMONS FLIP, pinned here because the shipped defaults moved to 'start' and 0 on 09/09/2026; without them this arm would run the meeple economy with the bonus in the wrong half of the turn and no meeples to start it, which measured a hook of 0.09 the one time anybody tried it. workers.roster.draw.drawUnderMeepleCurrency 2/2 - the Orchard door under the meeple arm, pinned for the same reason. WHAT IT MEASURED, so the arm can be read without opening a report: hook 0.31 rival visits per player per turn; the bonus mix LEVEL for the first time in this project's history, 31.2% rival visit against the empty-board Collect's 30.9%; door mix 29 / 28 / 23 / 12 / 8, the most even ever measured and a PASS; barn glut +1.0, doubled and the first movement in that number across four arms; 2-player blocked-want 8.1%, tripled, which reopened C57; actions per turn 1.31; game 2p 30.0 / 3p 26.5 / 4p 25.1 rounds; verdict 2 PASS / 3 FAIL / 8 OBSERVE. ⚠️ AND WHY IT IS NO LONGER THE GAME, WHICH IS THE ONE THING NO REPORT SAYS: it failed at a TABLE rather than in the simulator. Dean, 09/09/2026 - "with a meeple always available the bonus was basically free". A bonus that is always affordable is not a decision, and every number above was reporting that as a healthy visit rate. READ THAT BEFORE READING ANY OF THEM. ⚠️ THE BOTS ARE NOT THE reference-v14 BOTS. They are whatever the current evaluator is, and nothing re-tunes them when this flag flips, so a per-seat number here is today's opinion of yesterday's rules rather than a replay. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026, WHEN DEAN RULED IN THE PLAIN-ACTION BALLOONS AND THE VILLAGE STORE: the shipped defaults moved sixteen leaves at once - a flight now costs ONE barn card, the Aerodrome is in EVERY game, a flight MINTS at the Store, all four balloons pay their colour's plain action, and the six coin leaves are live. This control reproduces a game that predates all of it, so every one of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its old value. That is the 05/09/2026 lesson applied before the flip rather than after it: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved, or a control silently stops being a control. ⚠️ 13/09/2026: rules.turn.selfVisitAllowed true and rules.economy.noticeBoardsBySeats.2 1 are pinned here because the shipped defaults flipped when the commons was deleted, so this arm stays the game it was. ⛔ DELIVERY MEEPLE PINNED 14/09/2026: Dean ruled the delivery meeple ON as the shipped default (rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace 1, meepleSpendTiming 'afterAction', meepleSpendPerTurn 1, meepleSpendDistinctColours false) together with two new island rules, the space choice (rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice true: a delivery names either free space) and the closing draw (rules.turn.closingDrawPerCrate 1: filling a tile draws one card per crate). This overlay predates it, so all six leaves are pinned here BY NAME at their pre-ruling values (deliveryMeepleSpace null, meepleSpendTiming 'start', meepleSpendPerTurn null, meepleSpendDistinctColours false, deliverySpaceChoice false, closingDrawPerCrate 0; 'start' and null are the old inert values, not 'none' and 0) and it still replays its own game. Since 16/09/2026 the balloons, the Aerodrome, the Village Store, the closing draw and the wild substitution are deleted from the engine, so this overlay no longer replays the game it was recorded on. Its pins for the balloons and the Aerodrome, the Village Store and the closing draw were removed with them. ⚠️ 16/09/2026, THE TOKEN ISLAND AND THE TURN-ORDER RULINGS: the island is now two tokens per tile (Dean, R3: a first delivery pays both demands and chooses its token, a second pays the last token plus 2 any; Workers sit on the 3 and 4 VP tokens), and the Vegetable and Dairy boards were retexted (R9, R10), so this overlay's pins of rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice, rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace were removed with the delivery spaces. It pins rules.economy.noticeBoardPower.vegetableWildCards 0 and dairyDiscount 0 by name; under visitCurrency 'meeple' its island meeples now sit on the 3 and 4 VP tokens, and it now starts with seat 0 and gives one more turn each (rules.setup.firstPlayer 'seat0', rules.endGame.endOfGame 'oneMoreTurnEach'). It no longer replays the game it was recorded on, and nothing measured before 16/09/2026 is comparable as a level. ⛔ WHEAT BOARD RETEXT PINNED 19/09/2026: Dean retexted the Wheat Notice Board (sheet v44) to "Harvest one of your buildings, even if it is 1 card short of full", dropped the hand-to-barn rider (wheatBarn 0) and moved the harvest gate from 'loaded' to 'nearFull'. This overlay predates it and V12 The Auction House ("Discard a card from your Barn. Perform the Notice Board action of that crop") reaches the same power as a card effect under ANY visit currency, so both leaves are pinned here BY NAME at their pre-retext values (wheatBarn 1, wheatHarvestGate 'loaded') and it still replays its own game. ⛔ HAND LIMIT PINNED 24/09/2026: the simulator's hand bound moved from 7 to 10 (rules.turn.handLimit is an INSTRUMENT bound, never a table rule, CLAUDE.md 2.3; the move is reasoned in rules.json's meta.notes). This overlay predates that move and replays a game recorded under the bound of 7, so rules.turn.handLimit 7 is pinned here BY NAME and it still replays its own game.
